overview: A young man is rocked by two announcements from his elderly father: that he has terminal cancer, and that he has a young male lover.
tagline: This is what love feels like.

recs.blurb: After his lover rejects him, a young man trapped by the oppressiveness of Edwardian society tries to come to terms with and accept his sexuality.
